# fx · LedoCorp · for LLMs and agents

> Canonical public docs for the fx systems language (package version 0.9.68).
> Package: https://github.com/ledocorp/fxlang (GPL-3.0)
> Full as-implemented inventory: https://www.ledocorp.org/fx/docs/surface/ · repo `docs/SURFACE.md`
> Composition method: https://www.ledocorp.org/fx/docs/composition/ · Tracking: https://www.ledocorp.org/fx/docs/tracking/
> Agent loop: package `docs/AGENT.md` · Release notes: `docs/releases/0.9.68.md`

## Product

- Home: https://www.ledocorp.org/fx/
- Pitch: explicit systems language; named regions + effects; **native-first Auto** `fx run` (live `sh_*` when supported, foundry fallback); **IR → native** on foundry path; dual emission to readable C; wrap/host with C main
- Not a GC language; not a batteries-included app platform
- Prefer parallel `Vec`s + typed ids (SoA); host-minted `FsCap`/`OutCap` + `std/guest` for guests; ambient `std/io` for process-trust tools
- Surface: numeric tower, ownership/borrows, Result/?, structs/enums/match, generics (no traits), Vec/arrays/`&[T]`/`&mut [T]`/Map/StrBuilder/Buf, modules, extern "c"
- Also: sub-slices `a[lo..hi]`, Map dense iterate (`map_nth_*`), `Map<string,string>` (`map_new_ss`), grow ergonomics, Vec `v[i]` **reads** and no-grow `v[i]=x` / `vec_set` slot writes, array-backed `&mut [T]`, `std/pool` + typed **`Id`**, `map_add_i32` / `std/map.add_i32`, `lib/ring_queue` for `std/queue`
- Caps: `std/cap`, `std/io_cap`, `std/guest`; examples `cap_regions_*`, `cap_guest_ctx`, `cap_host_smoke`
- Week-two tools: `examples/tool_{files,bytes,tally,text,result}`
- Composition patterns: `examples/pattern_{ids,mut_table,grow_freeze,ring,pool}`
- Composition examples: `examples/composition_tally`, `examples/composition_reach`
- Dogfood: `examples/dogfood_{chip8,jsonget,chip8_ui,fxjson,textdiff,pathc_slots}`

## Package (source of binaries and examples)

- https://github.com/ledocorp/fxlang
- Quick path: put package `bin/` on PATH → `fx doctor` → `fx new hello` → `cd hello` → `fx run main.fx` (exit 42)
- zspec/libzspec resolve from the package beside `bin/` (not only cwd) — keep `bin/`, `zspec/`, `build/` together
- Also in repo: docs/ (incl. AGENT.md, SURFACE.md, COMPOSITION.md, TRACKING.md, EDITOR.md, DEBUG.md, releases/), scaffolds/, std/, lib/, examples/, zspec/, compiler-source/ (read-only)

## Day-one agent loop

```text
fx doctor
fx check path/to/main.fx
fx run path/to/main.fx
fx run path/to/main.fx --emit-c
fx emit-c path/to/main.fx -o out --debug-source
fx locate --c-file out/main.c --line <n>
fx mcp
```

## Before inventing code (routing)

```text
1. Path?  pure fx | --cli | --host+native (--use <dir>) | guest
2. Syntax? SURFACE — fx ≠ C (`,` in structs; Result `?`; hex colors are i32 bit-patterns)
3. APIs?  STD/SURFACE only — never invent std names
4. Link?  --use <dir> (loads link.args) — never invent winmm lists
5. Backend? host+GUI → --emit-c
```

Wrap: https://www.ledocorp.org/fx/docs/wrap/ · Std: https://www.ledocorp.org/fx/docs/std/

## As of 0.9.68 — can / cannot (agents)

**Can:** native-first Auto `fx run` (live `sh_*` for supported demos; honest fallback otherwise); IR→native when QBE staged (Linux `obj/qbe`; Windows `windows/qbe.exe`); emit readable C; regions/effects; SoA + pools; no-grow `v[i]=x` / `vec_set` under `mut`; `--cli` auto-host; Map&lt;string,string&gt;; typed `FsCap`/`OutCap` + guest; `fx lsp` / lean MCP; inspect `compiler-source/` (read-only).

**Cannot / not claimed:** growable `v[i]=x` that reallocates; Soft-fx / second mutation model; package registry; `fx run` program argv (use `--cli` / `--host`); every program on live `sh_*` without fallback; DAP debugger product; language-wide formal certification; “IR-only Windows” when `qbe.exe` is absent (use `--emit-c`); rebuild `bin/fx` from `compiler-source/` alone.
